title: Console backend APIs for querying Shadow Evals metrics (route/model/region/time window) w/ pagination + permissions
creator: Dylan Brooks
description:
Build Console backend APIs to query aggregated Shadow Traffic evaluation metrics for dashboards and rollout gating views.

Background
Shadow Traffic runs sampled production-shaped requests asynchronously against shadow targets and emits shadow_eval.* telemetry. Console needs a stable, permissioned query surface over pre-aggregated metrics (NOT raw prompts/outputs). This ticket focuses on Console backend service endpoints: time series + breakdowns by route/model/region/time window, with cursor pagination and permission checks.

Goals
- Provide API endpoints used by Shadow Evals dashboard MVP (DES-147 / ENG-2432) to retrieve aggregated quality + performance metrics.
- Support filters for: route (or route_group), primary model, shadow target model/version/quant profile, region, time window.
- Provide pagination for high-cardinality breakdown responses (e.g., many routes) without returning unbounded lists.
- Enforce strict permission checks (tenant scoping + role-based access): customer users can only see their own org/project, and only for routes they have access to.

Non-goals
- Building the metrics pipeline / tables themselves (owned by ENG-2427).
- Returning raw request payloads or model outputs (explicitly out of scope; privacy-sensitive and not required for dashboard MVP).

Proposed API surface (v1)
All endpoints are internal Console APIs (used by web UI) and return only aggregated metrics.

1) GET /v1/shadow-evals/summary
- Purpose: headline tiles (judge win-rate delta, format adherence, safety pass-rate, latency delta, cost delta) over a time window.
- Required params: start, end
- Optional filters: route_id, route_pattern (prefix match), primary_model, shadow_target_id, region

2) GET /v1/shadow-evals/timeseries
- Purpose: time series charts.
- Params: start, end, interval=[1m|5m|15m|1h|1d]
- Metric set: judge_win_rate, judge_tie_rate, format_adherence_rate, safety_pass_rate, p50_latency_ms_delta, p95_latency_ms_delta, tokens_out_delta, unit_cost_delta_usd
- Optional filters: route_id, primary_model, shadow_target_id, region

3) GET /v1/shadow-evals/breakdown
- Purpose: table breakdowns (e.g., by route, by region, by shadow_target).
- Params: start, end, group_by=[route|region|shadow_target|primary_model]
- Optional filters: route_id, primary_model, shadow_target_id, region
- Pagination: cursor-based (opaque cursor) + limit (default 50, max 200)
- Sort: sort_by=[judge_win_rate_delta|p95_latency_ms_delta|unit_cost_delta_usd] + sort_dir=[asc|desc]

Permission model
- Tenant scoping: enforce org_id + project/workspace scoping from auth context.
- Route access: enforce that queried route_id(s) belong to the tenant and are visible to the caller (respect existing Console route RBAC; align with Rollouts permissions).
- Admin override: Redwood internal admin may query across tenants ONLY via existing admin context; ensure request is audited by existing admin middleware.

Data source / query strategy
- Read from pre-aggregated analytics tables produced by telemetry pipeline (ENG-2427). For MVP, assume availability of:
  - shadow_eval_agg_timeseries (bucketed by time interval, org_id/project_id, route_id, region, shadow_target_id, primary_model)
  - shadow_eval_agg_breakdown (pre-aggregated rollups by common groupings)
- Do NOT join against raw event logs in the request path.
- Guardrails: respect metric cardinality allowlists/bucketing (ENG-2435). Backend should reject unsupported group_by/dim combinations to avoid accidental fan-out.

Acceptance criteria
- [x] Endpoints implemented and integrated into Console backend routing.
- [x] Cursor-based pagination implemented for /breakdown. Cursor must be opaque; avoid offset pagination.
- [x] Permissions enforced: cannot query another tenant; cannot query routes outside allowed set.
- [x] Input validation: start/end required; end-start max window enforced (default 30d, configurable); interval validation; limit bounds.
- [x] Performance: p95 API latency < 300ms for typical queries over 24h window and a single route; < 800ms for breakdown over top 50 routes (dependent on warehouse SLA).
- [x] Observability: emit api.* metrics and structured logs (no PII) including query shape, duration, result size, and error codes.
- [x] Unit tests for auth scoping, cursor paging, and validation; integration test coverage for one realistic query path.

Open questions
- Should we expose route_pattern filtering publicly in beta, or keep route_id-only until we validate cardinality? (Tentative: keep route_pattern internal-only / behind feature flag.)
- Final naming for “shadow_target_id” in API vs UI: UI may call it “candidate” but backend should use “shadow_target_id” aligned with policy schema.

- Metrics schema: sources/confluence/architecture-and-standards/observability-standards/shadow-eval-metrics-schema-and-tagging.json
